Axiom: A change touching exactly one line in exactly one file is NOT automatically safe — small size is not a proxy for low risk. Treat it with heightened, not relaxed, scrutiny: a one-character diff can be a typo fix, or it can be an off-by-one, a flipped operator, a silently changed default, or a fix at the wrong layer masking a deeper root cause. Before accepting a tiny diff at face value, actively look at the neighbouring lines and callers the one line touches — the smallness of the edit says nothing about the smallness of its effect.
